title: DeepSeekAPIOptions
description: Native DeepSeek Chat Completions request options used by Captain's OpenAI-compatible API runtime.

model.title: Model
model.description: DeepSeek chat or reasoner model identifier.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Conversation messages and tool results sent to DeepSeek.

max_tokens.title: Maximum output tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens generated in the completion.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature between zero and two.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Function tool definitions derived from Captain caller tools.

x-captain-option.note: Captain converts runtime Config.Tools into OpenAI-compatible function definitions.

tool_choice.title: Tool choice
tool_choice.description: Policy selecting whether and which function tool the model may call.

x-captain-option.note: Captain derives tool-call availability from the active tool loop.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: Whether the completion is returned as server-sent streaming events.

x-captain-option.note: Captain uses the provider streaming method for ExecuteStream.

stream_options.title: Stream options
stream_options.description: Additional behavior such as including a final usage chunk in the stream.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's compatibility adapter controls streaming metadata.

thinking.title: Thinking
thinking.description: Whether DeepSeek thinking mode is enabled for the request.

x-captain-option.note: Captain selects deepseek-reasoner by model ID instead of sending the native thinking object.

reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning effort
reasoning_effort.description: Relative reasoning effort requested from supported DeepSeek models.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's Genkit compatibility provider does not send DeepSeek's native reasoning_effort field.

stop.title: Stop sequences
stop.description: One or more text sequences that stop token generation.

x-captain-option.note: Captain has no stop-sequence Spec field.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Cumulative probability mass retained during nucleus sampling.

x-captain-option.note: Captain has no native top-p Spec field.

logprobs.title: Log probabilities
logprobs.description: Whether token log probabilities are included in the response.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not request token log probabilities.

top_logprobs.title: Top log probabilities
top_logprobs.description: Number of likely tokens returned with log probabilities at each position.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose token log-probability controls.

user_id.title: User ID
user_id.description: Stable end-user identifier used by DeepSeek for abuse detection.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not send a per-request DeepSeek user identifier.

frequency_penalty.title: Frequency penalty
frequency_penalty.description: Deprecated penalty based on how frequently a token has appeared.

x-captain-option.note: DeepSeek documents this option as deprecated and without effect.

presence_penalty.title: Presence penalty
presence_penalty.description: Deprecated penalty based on whether a token has appeared.

x-captain-option.note: DeepSeek documents this option as deprecated and without effect.
